_about: Neighbours join the fight (release 2; the design director's ruling of 22 November, 03:15Z, and his ruling 1 of 11:09Z; src/campaign/join.ts). The switch is stage.json's 'join'. A corps next door comes up by the game's own move rules, the same for the joiner, the staffs and the player: the week of its month it comes up in is weekOf of its move into the battle province (moveCost), out of the weeks it has in hand this month (a corps whose month is still to come has the weeks that month will give it). No corps comes up by train: the railway takes the whole month. It counts for the part of the battle it is there for, 1 less that week over 'window': up in the first week, three quarters (early); in the second, half (midway); in the third, a quarter (late). Up in the last week, it is no part of the battle.
